w1_final.reason: No loaded Event covers the specific November 12, 2026 unplanned cooling-water pressure loss at Micron's advanced-packaging facility, nor the resulting reduction in saleable-bit output, adjusted customer delivery dates, and recovery timeline through January 31, 2027. This is a distinct operational interruption event not represented in existing facts.

candidates.proposition: On November 12, 2026, an unexpected loss of cooling-water pressure in a shared utility loop at Micron's advanced-packaging area serving HBM and server-memory programs required placing a defined group of advanced packaging tools into a controlled safe state.
Micron reduced its expected saleable-bit output for the affected advanced-packaging programs during the current recovery period following the November 12, 2026 interruption.
Micron adjusted delivery dates for a limited set of customer commitments that had been scheduled to leave the affected packaging sequence before the end of December 2026.

Micron expects the physical repair work on the affected utility equipment to conclude during the week of November 18, 2026, with the advanced-packaging area remaining in recovery through January 31, 2027.

Micron did not attribute the November 12, 2026 interruption to demand conditions, customer specifications, or a product-quality issue, describing it solely as an operational disruption at a key manufacturing-support node.
